SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. REGISTER
No. S. B. D. 2970
Date June 24, 1937
Subject Japanese Language Research Association.
Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang. Forwarded by [签名]
With reference to the attached memo., inquiries
made by the staff of this section have failed to locate the
Sino-Japanese Lien Nyi Society and the Japanese Language
Research Association.
Mr. Yui Han-vung (俞漢文), who is reported to be
the Chairman of the Sino-Japanese Lien Nyi Society and to have
proposed the formation of the Japanese Language Research
Association, is the principal of the Dong Tsing Japanese
Language Supplementary School, No.11 West Lane, off Haining
Road. During March of this year he proceeded to Japan to study
education and returned to Shanghai on June 1. Therefore the
convention of the first preparatory meeting of the Japanese
Language Research Association on May 31, as mentioned in the
attached memo., cannot be regarded as authentic.
The Dong Tsing Japanese Language Supplementary
School, No.11 West Lane, off Haining Road, was established
about eleven years ago, and was registered with the Bureau of
Education in 1930. It has three classes - morning, afternoon,
and evening - which are attended by about 90 students. The
faculty consists of 2 Europeans, 2 Japanese and four Chinese.
The principal, Mr. Yui Han-vung, native of Chekiang,
aged 32, is a graduate of the Tung Wen College, Siccawei.
After his graduation in 1926, he established the above mentioned
school. Shortly afterwards he went to Japan where he studied
political science in the University of Japan for two years.
During his absence, one Zia Chung Tsuh (謝君澍) looked after
the school on his behalf. Upon his return, he continued to be
the principal. Up to the present nothing has occurred which
might suggest that he is in any way interested in or connected
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH 24 JUNE 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

机密
上海公共租界工部局警务处
S.1，特别股
报告
档案号 登记号 S. B. D. 2970
日期 1937年6月24日
事由 日语研究会。
由 C.D.I. 施子良（音译）撰写。转发人 [签名]
关于所附备忘录，经本股人员查询，未能找到“中日联谊社”及“日语研究会”。
据报担任“中日联谊社”社长并提出成立“日语研究会”的俞漢文先生，是海宁路旁西弄11号东清日语补习学校的校长。今年三月，他前往日本研习教育，并于6月1日返回上海。因此，所附备忘录中提及的5月31日召开的日语研究会第一次筹备会议，不能视为属实。
位于海宁路旁西弄11号的东清日语补习学校成立于约十一年前，并于1930年在教育局注册。该校设有早、午、晚三个班次，约有90名学生就读。教职员包括2名欧洲人、2名日本人和4名中国人。
校长俞漢文先生，浙江籍，现年32岁，毕业于徐家汇土山湾的文学院。1926年毕业后，他创办了上述学校。不久后他赴日本，在日本大学攻读政治学两年。在他离校期间，由谢君澍（音译）代为照管校务。回国后，他继续担任校长。截至目前，未发生任何表明他对任何政治运动感兴趣或与之有关联的情况。
（印：特别股 1937年6月24日 上海公共租界工部局警务处）

CONFIDENTIAL
Japanese Language Research Association Proposed
to hold a preparatory meeting.
------------------
According to information Mr. Yui Han-vung
(俞漢文), Principal of the Dong Tsing Japanese
Language Supplementary School and concurrently Chairman
of the Sino-Japanese Lien Nyi Society, has recently
proposed the formation of a body to be known as the
"Japanese Language Research Association".
It is learned that the first preparatory
meeting of the Association will be convened on May 31.
Enquiries are being proceeded with with a view to
obtaining further details of this Association.

629 Sih,
J.b.b.

pages.zh:
密件
拟召开日语研究会筹备会议。
------------------
据获悉，东清日语补习学校校长兼“中日联谊社”社长俞漢文先生，最近提议成立一个名为“日语研究会”的组织。
据悉，该协会的第一次筹备会议将于5月31日召开。
正在进行查询，以获取关于该协会的更多详情。

629 施，
J.b.b.
